description: Connect to toflow.ai to prospect, enrich, and run multi-channel outreach, all through ChatGPT. Search for people and companies using filters like title, seniority, industry, company size, and location. Enrich contacts to find verified emails, phone numbers, and LinkedIn profiles. Build and manage lists, then add contacts to outreach sequences via email, LinkedIn, and WhatsApp. Create deals, log calls, create tasks, and track email opens without leaving the chat.
